integrity: The surface and its two Hirzebruch--Jung strings are taken from the cited primary literature. The discrepancy vectors, local indices, and all plurigenera through degree 98 are reconstructed exactly from those strings and Blache's formula. The bundled verifier uses rational arithmetic and is not an empirical approximation.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the canonical Cartier index and exact plurigenus thresholds only through degree 98. It does not compute canonical-ring generators or relations, base loci, or the first birational pluricanonical map.
title: Pluricanonical thresholds of the minimal-volume rank-one surface
